_about: Jr's own merge switches (SPEC-demand-work-consumer.md, 'Machine review of a demand PR'). Each flag is turned on by a reviewed PR to this file; the matching repository variable (JR_DEMAND_AUTOMERGE, JR_TICK_AUTOMERGE, JR_CODE_AUTOMERGE) set to 0 is the instant kill switch that needs no PR. Both must allow before a canary merges anything.
